mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10Y-2Y < 0) within the next 6 months, or GDP growth decelerates in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, exceeding a 2% month-over-month decline, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate, with an increase of more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months, signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence rises by more than 5 points in the following month, or SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4%, a further increase of more than 25 basis points in a single month signals an aggressive tightening cycle that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or the federal funds rate is cut by more than 50 basis points in the following 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts are below their 12-month moving average, an increase of more than 5% in a single month signals a revival in the housing sector that will boost economic growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 12mo MA and rises > 5% in 1 month
failure_condition: Housing starts decline by more than 10% in the following 3 months, or SPX returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 5%, a decline of more than 0.3 percentage points in a single month signals an accelerating labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Initial jobless claims rise by more than 10% in the following month, or SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production is above its 6-month moving average, a decline of more than 1% in a single month signals a supply chain disruption that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 6mo MA and declines > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: ISM Manufacturing PMI rises above 55 in the following month, or SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI is above 3%, a further increase of more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month signals an accelerating inflationary environment that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation declines by more than 0.3 percentage points in the following quarter, or SPX returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.
